content: OpenVLA: 7B-parameter open-source VLA, trained on 970k robot demos (Open X-Embodiment), dual vision encoders (DINOv2+SigLIP), Llama 2 backbone. Outperforms RT-2-X (55B) by 16.5% at 7x fewer parameters. Fine-tuning: LoRA updates only 1.4% of params, runs on consumer GPUs, no success rate drop with 4-bit quantization. OpenVLA-OFT recipe adds parallel decoding, action chunking, continuous action representation, L1 regression objective — achieves 97.1% on LIBERO. Apache/MIT licensed. HuggingFace distribution. Strong multi-task, multi-robot generalization.
